rows.source: Gear drops from monsters (each one’s RO drops) and belongs to the account: all your characters share it. Dying never costs you what you already had. During the run, what a monster drops falls on the ground: the piece, with the beam of its quality, or the card. It comes to you when you get close, from quite far away and without pausing the run, and tells you what it is. Even if you do not pick it up, it is already yours. If the run cannot be claimed when it ends (the game closes or the connection drops), its loot goes into your account when you come back in. In a group, everyone sees and picks up their own, and everything is shared out at the end.
